name: Generate SEO title & description
description: Creates locale-aware SEO meta for a page from its body copy and primary keyword.

definition.template: Write an SEO title (max 60 chars) and meta description (max 155 chars) for the content. Keyword: {{keyword}}. Tone: {{tone}}.

name: Summarize release notes
description: Condenses changelog bullets into a short customer-facing summary.

definition.template:
Summarize these release notes for customers in 3–5 bullets. Avoid internal codenames.

{{notes}}

name: Translate field value
description: Translates a source locale string into target locales used by the space.

definition.template:
Translate from {{sourceLocale}} to {{targetLocale}}. Preserve product names and keep markdown intact.

{{text}}

Rewrite to match brand voice: {{voiceGuidelines}}. Keep meaning, keep length roughly similar.

{{copy}}

name: Generate product FAQ
description: Creates a concise FAQ from product specs and support ticket themes.

name: Extract entities from article
description: Pulls people, orgs, products, and locations for tagging and search facets.

definition.template:
Extract named entities from the text. Return JSON arrays for people, organizations, products, locations.

{{text}}

name: Suggest image alt text
description: Generates accessible alt text with length guidance and avoids keyword stuffing.

name: Redact PII in support snippets
description: Redacts emails, phone numbers, addresses, and order numbers in pasted support text.

definition.template:
Redact PII with tokens: [EMAIL], [PHONE], [ADDRESS], [ORDER]. Return redacted text only.

{{text}}

name: Generate hero section copy
description: Produces headline, subhead, and CTA suggestions for landing pages.

definition.template: Generate 3 options for headline, subhead, and CTA. Product: {{product}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Value props: {{valueProps}}

name: Validate markdown style
description: Checks markdown for broken links, heading order, and common formatting issues.

definition.template: Validate the markdown. Return issues with line numbers when possible. Output JSON: {issues:[{severity,message,line}]}.

name: Create blog post outline
description: Generates an H2/H3 outline and suggested section notes from a topic brief.

name: Legacy prompt: press quote
description: Old press-quote generator kept for audit; do not use.

definition.template: Write a punchy quote about {{product}} for a press release. Tone: enthusiastic.

name: Generate URL slug
description: Creates a kebab-case slug from a title, avoiding stop-words and preserving acronyms.

definition.template:
Generate a short URL slug from the title. Use kebab-case. No dates unless in title.

Title: {{title}}

name: Generate A/B test variants
description: Creates multiple copy variants for email subject lines or CTA buttons.

definition.template: Generate {{count}} variants for: {{baseCopy}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Return as JSON array of strings.

name: Prompt experiment: legal disclaimer rewriter
description: Removed after policy review; retained as tombstone row.

definition.template:
Rewrite disclaimer to be clearer without changing meaning.

{{text}}

name: Localize CTA button text
description: Suggests localized CTA labels that fit common button widths.

definition.template:
Localize the CTA into {{targetLocale}}. Keep it under 22 characters if possible.

CTA: {{cta}}

name: Draft lifecycle email
description: Drafts lifecycle email copy with subject, preview text, and body.

name: Compliance phrasing check (EU)
description: Flags risky marketing phrases for EU pages; temporarily disabled due to false positives.

definition.template:
Identify potentially non-compliant marketing claims. Output JSON list with snippets and category.

{{copy}}

name: Generate code snippet for docs
description: Creates short SDK examples from an API endpoint description.

name: Changelog to social post
description: Turns a changelog line into a short social post with optional link.

name: Classify article category
description: Assigns a primary category based on taxonomy and editorial rules.

definition.template:
Pick the best category from this list: {{categories}}. Use the text to decide. Return JSON {category,confidence,reason}.

{{text}}

Write a caption in {{style}} style. Keep it under 20 words.

Context: {{context}}

name: Lightweight fact-check prompts
description: Flags sentences that likely require citations or verification; not a source of truth.

definition.template:
Mark claims that should be verified. Return JSON array of {claim,why}.

{{text}}

name: Draft job posting
description: Creates a job description with responsibilities, requirements, and salary range note.

name: Generate screening questions
description: Creates role-specific screening questions for ATS intake forms.

definition.template: Generate 8 screening questions for {{role}}. Mix yes/no and short answer. Avoid discriminatory questions.

name: Write support macro reply
description: Drafts a helpful support response from issue summary and account context.

definition.template: Write a support response. Be polite, concise, and include next steps. Product: {{product}}. Issue: {{issue}}. Account tier: {{tier}}.

name: Tag ticket sentiment
description: Tags support tickets with sentiment and urgency labels for triage queues.

definition.template:
Classify sentiment (positive/neutral/negative) and urgency (low/medium/high). Return JSON.

{{text}}

name: Grade submission with rubric
description: Scores a submission against a rubric and returns structured feedback.

name: Generate hints (no spoilers)
description: Creates incremental hints for a problem statement without revealing the full answer.

name: Meeting notes to tasks
description: Extracts action items, owners, and due dates from meeting notes.

definition.template:
Extract action items with owner and due date when present. Return JSON array of {task,owner,dueDate}.

{{notes}}

name: QBR summary generator
description: Creates an exec summary from quarterly metrics and highlights.

name: Auto-tag blog post
description: Suggests tags from a controlled vocabulary and returns top matches with confidence.

definition.template:
Given allowed tags: {{allowedTags}}. Pick up to {{maxTags}} relevant tags. Return JSON {tags:[{tag,confidence}]}.

{{content}}

name: Suggest internal links
description: Suggests internal links to other pages based on a sitemap slice and the draft text.

name: Generate social card copy
description: Generates OG title/description and image overlay text for social previews.
